definitions.explanation: To eat or drink noisily by sucking in liquid or noodles; to sip.

examples.japanese: お{茶|ちゃ}を{啜|すす}りながら{話|はなし}をする。

notes:
CONJUGATION:
- {啜|すす}らない (negative)
- {啜|すす}ります (polite)
- {啜|すす}って (te-form)
- {啜|すす}った (past)

CULTURAL NOTES:
- Slurping noodles is considered acceptable and even desirable in Japanese culture, as it shows appreciation for the food.
- {鼻|はな}を{啜|すす}る (to sniffle) is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {麺|めん}を{啜|すす}る (to slurp noodles)
- スープを{啜|すす}る (to sip soup)
